titles.title: Expanding Whistleblower Protections for Contractors Act of 2026
A bill to ensure that whistleblowers, including contractors, are protected from retaliation when a Federal employee orders a reprisal, and for other purposes.
Expanding Whistleblower Protections for Contractors Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 465.
